summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC filed a Form 6-K on 1 September 2026 disclosing its total voting rights and capital as of 31 August 2026, pursuant to UK Disclosure and Transparency Rule 5.6.1. The registrant reported issued share capital of 153,593,895 ordinary shares, of which 5,431,782 are held in treasury, resulting in 148,162,113 total voting rights. It also noted share purchases subject to cancellation under shareholder authority granted at the AGM on 7 May 2026. This is a routine regulatory notification with no transaction, merger, or other corporate event.
